shared_elements: schematic linear signs incised/painted on a rock surface
roughly horizontal alignment of small repeated marks
justification: The only correspondences are generic: both surfaces carry small linear marks laid out in a broadly horizontal band, and both include a cross-like geometric sign, features any linear mark-making tradition could produce independently. A depicts a narrative scene of schematic stick-like human figures with raised weapons plus an animal and cup marks, whereas B depicts framed registers of alphabetic script above a large symmetrical foliate cross with scrolled terminals — entirely different subject matter, with no shared figural or compositional scheme.
